purpose: Read-only V6 status reporting policy. Reports may remind and summarize, but must not trigger orders.

daily: Check whether V6-A/V6-B jobs ran as expected.
Check whether any order, quote, account, or OpenD exception appeared.
Do not make strategy-level changes from daily noise.
weekly: Review V6-A target vs actual positions.
Review weekly return, max drawdown, worst day, and execution drift.
Review whether V6-B live-forward data remains clean.
Decide whether to continue, pause, or refresh release gate.
monthly: Run Missing Opportunity Review for Dynamic Universe.
Refresh V6-B point-in-time candidates if evidence supports it.
Do not promote V6-B without standalone, V6-A comparison, allocator, and replay evidence.
quarterly: Run deterministic replay, release gate, black swan windows, rolling 3y/5y, robustness, and live tradability checks.
Review V6 Engine parameters and Core Pool candidates.
Any production change must update V6_STRATEGY_LAB.md, AI Wiki, and SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.

boundaries: Reporting is read-only and must not place orders.
Email output is a reminder and cannot be used as an automatic trading trigger.
V6-A real pilot still requires explicit manual confirmation before each first live execution stage.
V6-B remains research/simulation only until point-in-time, OOS, replay, allocator, and tradability evidence pass.
Allocator changes capital weights only after evidence; it is a risk-control layer, not a performance-chasing layer.

email.boundary: Email is read-only and must not trigger trading.
